Another,Ⓒa.Ⓓanya-itara-para-apara pron. a.; or aMtaraM in comp.; nagarAMtaraM ‘a(nother) city’; ‘in a(nother) place’ anyatra; ‘in a(nother) manner’ anyaTA; ‘at a(nother) time’ anyadA; ‘a(nother) day’ anyedyuH, paredyuH; ‘one after a(nother)’ anupUrvaSaH, ekEkaSaH.
